thread:
dalia: Heads-up — Hyperlane wants to POC a direct swap from CompetitorX's API. They're mainly worried about prompt parity, response shape, rate limits, and token accounting for pricing. Who can own tech presales on this?
ryan: I can lead tech presales. Need their example prompts + target latency/billing SLAs. cc @sanjay for security questionnaire items.
sanjay: I have their security questionnaire. Two immediate blockers: they require HSM-backed key rotation and prefer a private-VPC deployment. Also clarifying retention windows for logs.
mei: We support KMS integrations and audit logs. Private VPC/onprem timeline is ~4–6 weeks; for an initial pilot we can use Dedicated with tenant isolation. Pricing-wise, recommend a temporary pilot discount for committed QPS.
dalia: Perfect. Can someone prototype a tiny compat shim that accepts CompetitorX's payload and emits our API shape? They send `prompt_pairs` and `max_output_tokens`.
ryan: I'll sketch a minimal mapping and a curl example to hand to pre-sales.
ryan: ```
# competitor -> redwood pseudo-mapping
# competitor payload:
{
  "prompt_pairs": [{"prompt": "summarize", "context": "doc"}],
  "max_output_tokens": 300
}
# redwood payload:
{
  "input": "summarize

context: doc",
  "max_tokens": 300,
  "model": "redwood-1"
}
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"...","max_tokens":300}'
```
sanjay: Add to that: for this customer we must strip PII before forwarding requests. They also insist on customer-managed keys (envelope encryption) — legal will need to review the KMS/HSM approach.
mei: On prompt parity: CompetitorX tends to run temperature=0.0 and a custom system prompt; outputs will differ. We should set expectations and run an A/B on ~200 seed prompts for parity metrics. I can run the evals in the POC workspace.
dalia: Sales needs a pricing estimate for 100M tokens/month with p99 latency target of 200ms and a fallback SLA. Can you give a back-of-envelope so I can draft the SOW?
ryan: Back-of-envelope: hosted per-1k-token rate -> placeholder $0.00X, so 100M tokens -> ~$Y/month (will fill with exact numbers). For sustained 100M tokens, recommend Reserved Dedicated commit — better unit economics and predictable latency. I'll put numbers into a spreadsheet.
dalia: @sanjay any security/legal blockers that would prevent us from starting a staging POC this week?
sanjay: HSM full integration is the only show-stopper. If they accept cloud KMS with CMK plus an attestation timeline, we can start pilot immediately. Legal needs the DPA signed before production data. I'll loop legal now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created POC workspace `hyperlane-poc` and added `ryan`, `dalia`, `mei`, `sanjay`.
dalia: Next steps: Ryan — prototype shim and post PR by EOD Tue. Mei — seed ~200 prompts and run initial evals by Wed. Sanjay — send security answers + DPA draft to customer and confirm KMS approach. I'll prepare the initial pricing sheet and SOW draft.
ryan: :thumbsup: starting on shim now, will post PR link here.
mei: :white_check_mark: I have a seed set from a similar finance customer; will upload to `hyperlane-poc`.
sanjay: :eyes: pinging legal and security; will update thread with any blockers.
dalia: Thanks all — I'll sync with account exec after initial shim + evals are in.
